title: Vendor Region Map
noVendorsHint: Query after choosing dates — vendors with matched route codes appear here.
profitCaveat: Theoretical profit: inbound volume × region package price, regardless of whether parcels were eventually signed — so it runs higher than the settled amounts in Dispatch Performance.
profitUnpriced: {{count}} parcels had no matching price in the region price table; none of their money is included.
loadingWait: Matching routes and aggregating by postcode — usually tens of seconds. Waited {{seconds}}s
noVendorsSelected: All vendors deselected — columns hidden on map
noScanData: No mappable arrival scans for this date range — try other dates
legendHeight_vendorProfit: Column height = vendor profit in postcode
legendHeight_courierProfit: Column height = courier profit in postcode
legendHeightHint: Square-root scale; equal base — compare heights across postcodes
legendVendorTitle: Color = top vendor by volume/value in postcode
legendVendorHint: Colors match the vendor filter above — darker means higher delivery density
warehouseHint: Concentric rings show distance from warehouse {{scale}} — fade when zoomed in

trend.queryHint: Pull day-by-day arrival data — longer ranges are slower (~5–15s for 14 days)
trend.failedDates: {{count}} day(s) failed to load — excluded from all stats (not treated as zero)
trend.dirtyDates: {{count}} day(s) had volume below {{threshold}} — treated as dirty data and excluded from all stats
trend.emptyHint: Choose a stat date range and click Query.
trend.todayExcluded: · today's incomplete data excluded from MoM
trend.thisWeekExcluded: · this week's incomplete data excluded from MoM
trend.momHintDay: Split range in half — recent vs prior daily avg ({{days}} comparable days). Drops ranked first — likely driver cuts.
trend.momHintWeek: Split range in half — recent vs prior weekly avg ({{days}} comparable weeks). Drops ranked first — likely driver cuts.
trend.routeHeatmapHint: One route code ≈ one driver line. Row fading out = line went dry; new row = capacity added.
trend.chartEmptyQuery: Click Query to show daily volume trend.
trend.heatmapEmptyQuery: Click Query to show route distribution.
trend.heatmapEmptyVendor: {{name}} has no route data in this range.
trend.barInsufficient: Fewer than 2 comparable days — extend the range.
trend.barAllNew: No comparable vendors (all new in range).
trend.noVendorsMatched: Fetched scans but no vendor route matches

missingImileToken: Configure iMile Token in global settings first
